title: RBI Imposes Penalties on IndusInd Bank and Three NBFCs for Regulatory Lapses
description: <cite index="51-1,51-3">RBI imposed a Rs 59.20 lakh penalty on IndusInd Bank for non-compliance with certain provisions of directions on deposit rates and securitisation of standard assets.</cite> <cite index="51-5,51-6">Fusion Finance was penalised Rs 2.7 lakh for non-compliance with the RBI's KYC Directions, Muthoot MCred was fined Rs 3.1 lakh for non-compliance with RBI directions on asset classification.</cite>
